interpretation: Current HCAI identifies Adventist Health Bakersfield at 2615 Chester (HCAI ID 106150788) and separately identifies Adventist Health Specialty Bakersfield at 3001 Sillect (HCAI ID 106154101); the first-party operator appendix also lists them separately. CMS identifies San Joaquin Community Hospital as CCN 050455 but its cited record is historical and uses an older Eye Street address. The current first-party portal routes both Bakersfield labels to the same database, and the pointer-linked file header at 3001 Sillect identifies San Joaquin Community Hospital plus the Specialty facility. Thus the file has independently corroborated Specialty-campus identity, but remains mismatched to the main 050455 roster facility; distinct facility identity evidence does not establish shared Medicare CCN scope. The earlier unbound partial header cannot override URL-bound bytes. No corrected main-campus MRF or authoritative scope statement was found, so 050455 remains unresolved.
next_action: Request a publisher-corrected pointer-linked MRF or authoritative explanation tying the exact current file's 3001 Sillect Avenue locations to CCN 050455 at 2615 Chester Avenue; if replaced, capture the exact final URL, response bytes/hash, facility address/state, CMS version/date and usability. Preserve the current file hash and do not treat the lost-URL partial as evidence.
no_change: No disposition change or new MRF recovery; CCN 050455 remains unresolved with the file/address conflict visible. New evidence is independent facility identity/address corroboration (main versus Specialty), not new MRF bytes and not resolution credit.
